title: Rollout Roulette: A Probabilistic Inference Approach to Inference-Time Scaling of LLMs using Particle-Based Monte Carlo Methods
authors_zh: Isha Puri、Shivchander Sudalairaj、Guangxuan Xu、Kai Xu、Akash Srivastava（机构：麻省理工学院计算机科学与人工智能实验室、Red Hat AI Innovation）
paper_type_zh: 概率推理测试时扩展与搜索研究
best_for_zh: 在不完美过程奖励模型下设计稳健多轨迹推理的读者。
one_line: Rollout Roulette uses particle filtering to preserve diverse reasoning trajectories under process-reward uncertainty.
Rollout Roulette 利用粒子滤波在过程奖励不确定时保留多样化的推理轨迹。
why: It turns reward-guided reasoning search into uncertainty-aware trajectory allocation rather than greedy pruning.
inclusion_reason: It changes how inference-time rollouts are retained and resampled to use computation without deterministic early pruning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reward-guided search can spend more inference computation on promising partial solutions, but beam-like methods discard candidates as soon as an imperfect process reward model assigns them a low early score. A trajectory that starts weakly can later become correct, whereas a reward-hacked trajectory can look attractive at the first few steps. Greedy pruning therefore turns an uncertain score into an irreversible allocation decision.

The paper asks how a fixed rollout budget can preserve exploration without ignoring reward information. Its target is not simply to generate more chains: it is to decide which partial trajectories remain alive after each reasoning step, so that noisy early judgments do not consume all computation or eliminate the only route to a correct answer.

奖励引导的搜索能够把更多推理计算投入看似有希望的部分解，但类束搜索方法会在不完美的过程奖励模型很早给出低分时立即丢弃候选。一条起步较弱的轨迹可能后来变得正确；相反，一条迎合奖励的轨迹在前几步也可能显得很有吸引力。因此，贪心裁剪把带有不确定性的分数变成了不可逆的计算分配决定。

论文研究固定的采样预算如何在不忽略奖励信息的前提下保留探索。它的目标不只是生成更多思维链，而是决定每一步推理之后哪些部分轨迹仍然存活，使带噪声的早期判断既不会耗尽全部计算，也不会删除通向正确答案的唯一途径。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper recasts inference-time scaling as approximate posterior inference in a state-space model. The language model is the transition model that expands a partial trajectory, while a process reward model provides an approximate observation of step acceptability. Rather than pursuing only the single highest-scoring mode, the system keeps a weighted population of candidate trajectories representing uncertainty over acceptable solutions.

Particle filtering supplies the allocation rule. High-reward trajectories receive more weight, but stochastic resampling means they do not immediately monopolize the budget and lower-scoring alternatives can survive. The key idea is to use reward values as noisy likelihood evidence, not as a final deterministic verdict; computation is consequently shared between exploitation of good paths and exploration of paths whose value has not yet been resolved.

论文将测试时扩展重新表述为状态空间模型中的近似后验推断。语言模型是扩展部分轨迹的转移模型，而过程奖励模型提供步骤可接受性的近似观测。系统不再只追逐得分最高的单一模式，而是保留一组带权重的候选轨迹，用来表示对可接受解答的不确定性。

粒子滤波提供计算分配规则。高奖励轨迹获得更大权重，但随机重采样意味着它们不会立即垄断预算，得分较低的替代路径仍有机会存活。关键思想是把奖励数值当作带噪声的似然证据，而不是最终的确定判决；因此，计算会在利用较好路径和探索价值尚未确定的路径之间共享。

title: Method
方法
html:
Each particle represents a partial reasoning trajectory. The system extends particles with the language model, scores the new partial states with a process reward model, updates particle weights, and resamples a new population using a softmax distribution over those weights. It repeats this generation–scoring–resampling cycle until full solutions exist, then uses the reported final-answer selection protocol for comparison with other methods.

The paper also studies how the same framework distributes budget across iterations and parallel chains, including Particle Gibbs and parallel tempering variants. Partial trajectories, step rewards, normalized weights, resampling ancestry, and final answers are the operational records. Because generation and reward scoring can run across particles in parallel, the method makes the trade-off between more parallel candidates and deeper sequential refinement explicit.

每个粒子代表一条部分推理轨迹。系统用语言模型扩展粒子，用过程奖励模型给新的部分状态评分，更新粒子权重，再按照这些权重上的 softmax 分布重采样出新的粒子群。它重复生成、评分和重采样的循环，直到形成完整解答，随后采用论文报告的最终答案选择协议与其他方法比较。

论文还研究同一框架如何在迭代次数和并行链之间分配预算，包括粒子 Gibbs 与并行回火变体。部分轨迹、步骤奖励、归一化权重、重采样祖先关系和最终答案构成运行记录。由于生成与奖励评分可以在多个粒子上并行，方法明确呈现了更多并行候选与更深顺序细化之间的权衡。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The NeurIPS paper evaluates particle filtering against greedy generation, self-consistency, best-of-N, beam search, and other reward-guided scaling baselines. It reports mathematical evaluation on MATH500 and AIME 2024, as well as broader reasoning tests including NumGLUE Chemistry and FinanceBench. The study also ablates reward models, reward aggregation, temperature, and the split between parallel and iterative computation.

The authors report a 4–16 times better scaling rate than deterministic-search counterparts, and report that Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct surpasses GPT-4o accuracy with four rollouts while the 7B model reaches the reported o1-level comparison with 32 rollouts. These are benchmark-specific comparisons under selected reward models and budgets; reproductions should report reward-model quality, total tokens, rollout count, parallel resources, and accuracy together.

这篇 NeurIPS 论文将粒子滤波与贪心生成、自一致性、最佳 N 选择、束搜索以及其他奖励引导的扩展基线比较。它在 MATH500 和 2024 年 AIME 上进行数学评测，也在 NumGLUE Chemistry 与 FinanceBench 等更广泛推理任务上测试。研究还消融了奖励模型、奖励聚合、温度，以及并行计算与迭代计算之间的划分。

作者报告，相比确定性搜索对手，方法的扩展速率高出 4 至 16 倍；并报告 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct 用四次采样超过 GPT-4o 的准确率，而 7B 模型用 32 次采样达到所述的 o1 水平比较。这些都是在选定奖励模型和预算下的基准比较；复现时应同时报告奖励模型质量、总令牌、采样次数、并行资源和准确率。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior reward-guided reasoning search generally treats a high partial reward as a reason to retain a trajectory and a low reward as a reason to delete it. Rollout Roulette replaces this deterministic top-N decision with posterior sampling over a population of weighted candidates. It therefore addresses reward-model uncertainty at the allocation layer rather than assuming a better reward model can eliminate the problem.

The contribution also links classical sequential Monte Carlo concepts to concrete reasoning controls: particle weights, stochastic resampling, reward aggregation, and the division of budget between parallel and iterative computation. The novelty is not just a new search label; it changes the semantics of a partial reward from a hard pruning threshold to probabilistic evidence that can still preserve alternative solution modes.

以往奖励引导的推理搜索通常把较高的部分奖励视为保留轨迹的理由，把较低奖励视为删除轨迹的理由。Rollout Roulette 用带权候选群上的后验采样替代这种确定性的前 N 决定。因此，它在分配层面处理奖励模型的不确定性，而不是假定只要有更好的奖励模型就能消除问题。

这项贡献还把经典序贯蒙特卡洛概念连接到具体的推理控制：粒子权重、随机重采样、奖励聚合，以及并行计算和迭代计算之间的预算划分。新意不只是换了一个搜索名称；它改变了部分奖励的语义，使其从硬性的裁剪阈值变成仍可保留替代解答模式的概率证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method still depends on a process reward model for its approximate likelihood, so systematic reward error can distort particle weights and resampling. More particles, step-level scoring, and iterative resampling also introduce engineering cost and may suffer particle degeneracy or latency under limited parallel hardware. The reported comparisons are mainly on structured reasoning tasks, so open-ended generation requires separate evidence and a suitable final-answer selection rule.
该方法仍依赖过程奖励模型提供近似似然，因此系统性的奖励误差可能扭曲粒子权重和重采样。更多粒子、步骤级评分和迭代重采样也会带来工程成本，并可能在并行硬件有限时遭遇粒子退化或延迟问题。报告的比较主要针对结构化推理任务，所以开放式生成仍需要单独证据和合适的最终答案选择规则。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this method when a service already has step-level reward signals but deterministic beam-style pruning loses diverse solution paths. Log every particle's partial text, reward, normalized weight, parent, resampling event, total tokens, and final correctness. Evaluate the same total generation budget against beam search and self-consistency, and separately test whether improved accuracy survives when the reward model, temperature, or number of workers changes.
当服务已经具有步骤级奖励信号，但确定性的束式裁剪会丢失多样化解答路径时，可以使用该方法。应记录每个粒子的部分文本、奖励、归一化权重、父节点、重采样事件、总令牌和最终正确性。在相同总生成预算下与束搜索和自一致性比较，并单独检验当奖励模型、温度或工作节点数变化时，准确率提升是否仍然成立。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the method as an allocation policy, not as a claim that all random search is superior. The important contrast is between retaining posterior mass and retaining only the current mode under an imperfect PRM. Inspect the reward aggregation choice and resampling temperature, then check the ablation on parallel versus iterative budget: these settings determine whether the method explores genuinely different reasoning paths or merely duplicates noisy partial traces.
应把方法理解为一项分配策略，而不是“所有随机搜索都更好”的主张。关键对比是在不完美过程奖励模型下保留后验质量，还是只保留当前模式。应检查奖励聚合选择和重采样温度，再检查并行预算与迭代预算的消融：这些设定决定方法是在探索真正不同的推理路径，还是只复制带噪声的部分轨迹。
